qa.question: What does an "add X000 to the maximum your DP-based deletion effects can delete" effect do?
qa.answer:
Such effects increase the maximum value shown for DP-based deletion effects.
For example, while "[Your Turn] Add 1000 to the maximum your DP-based deletion effects can delete" is activated, "[When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less" will allow you to delete an opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less.

qa.question: If "add X000 to the maximum your DP-based deletion effects can delete" is activating, can the maximum be increased for an effect such as "delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with DP less than or equal to this Digimon's DP" that references a Digimon's DP for deletion?
qa.answer:
No, it can't be increased.
You can't increase the maximum of a DP-based deletion effect that doesn't show a numerical value.

For example, if there are two level 5 cards in this Digimon’s digivolution cards, you can trash both to prevent this Digimon from being deleted or returned to your hand or deck.

Performing the check causes a card to be removed from your opponent’s security stack, causing this card’s [All Turns] effect to trigger. If you flip over a card with a [Security] effect, however, the [Security] effect will trigger afterwards, which means it will activate first.

qa.answer: Yes. When there are multiple Digimon tied for lowest DP, you can choose any of them. This means you can choose the Digimon with the effect preventing deletion to get the “if no Digimon was deleted by this effect” part of the effect.

No. For this card's effect you reveal cards, add 1 card with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in its traits among them to your hand, then trash 1 card with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in its traits among them.
Therefore, if there is only 1 card with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in its traits among the revealed cards, it's first added to the hand, so you can't trash it.

qa.question: If I have cards in my trash with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in their traits, does this card's inherited effect let me digivolve any card into any of them, regardless of digivolution requirements?
qa.answer: No. This effect can’t ignore digivolution requirements. When activating this effect, you can only digivolve into a card with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in its traits if it also meets the digivolution requirements.

qa.question: I activate this card’s inherited effect to digivolve into a card with a [When Attacking] effect. Does that effect activate immediately?
qa.answer: No. The [When Attacking] effect wasn't present when you declared the attack, so it doesn't activate.

qa.question: If I have cards in my trash with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in their traits, does this card's inherited effect let me digivolve any card into any of them, regardless of digivolution requirements?
qa.answer: No. This effect can’t ignore digivolution requirements. When activating this effect, you can only digivolve into a card with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in its traits if it also meets the digivolution requirements.

qa.question: I activate this card’s inherited effect to digivolve into a card with a [When Attacking] effect. Does that effect activate immediately?
qa.answer: No. The [When Attacking] effect wasn't present when you declared the attack, so it doesn't activate.

qa.question: When this card is in the digivolution cards of a Digimon with an effect that adds colors, such as “This Digimon is also treated as red,” does this card’s inherited effect activate?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: If this card’s [On Play][When Digivolving] effect trashes a card that’s both purple and yellow, can I both delete 1 of my opponent’s level 3 Digimon and give 1 of my opponent’s Digimon -3000 DP for the turn?
qa.answer: Yes. A 2-color card is treated as both colors, so you can activate both effects.

qa.question: When this card is in the digivolution cards of a Digimon with an effect that adds colors, such as “This Digimon is also treated as red,” does this card’s inherited effect activate?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: Does this card’s [Your Turn] effect let me digivolve into a card in my trash?
qa.answer:
No, this card can’t digivolve into a card from your trash on its own.
When some other card’s effect digivolves this card into a card from your trash, this card’s effect will then reduce the digivolution cost.

qa.question: If I have cards in my trash with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in their traits, does this card's [End of Attack] effect let me digivolve any card into them, regardless of digivolution requirements?
qa.answer: No. This effect can’t ignore digivolution requirements. When activating this effect, you can only digivolve into a card with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in its traits if it also meets the digivolution requirements.

qa.question: If I have 1 or fewer security cards, can I still play a purple or yellow Digimon card with 6000 DP or less from my trash with this card’s [On Play] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: If I have 1 or fewer security cards and activate this card’s [On Play] effect to play a level 6 or lower Digimon card with [Angel] or [Fallen Angel] in its traits, do I play it from my trash?
qa.answer: Yes, you do.

qa.question: If this card is in my trash, is it counted as a card with [Dex] in its name by this card’s [On Deletion] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, it is.

qa.question: If there are 5 or more cards with [Dex] or [DeathX] in their names in my trash, can I still activate this card’s [On Deletion] effect to play a purple or black level 3 Digimon card from my trash?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: When playing this card from my trash with this card’s [On Deletion] effect, does it return to the battle area with any digivolution cards it had prior to being deleted?
qa.answer: No, only this card itself is returned to play. Any digivolution cards it had are placed in your trash.

qa.question: When playing this card from my trash with this card's [On Deletion] effect, do any effects it had prior to being deleted persist once it re-enters play?
qa.answer: No. It’s treated as a new Digimon that just entered play. Any effects it had prior to being deleted are not carried over.

qa.question: I activated this card's [When Digivolving] effect, and when my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area for the 1st process, an immediate-type effect such as a "when [...] would leave" effect caused this card to be removed from the battle area. Can I then process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's effect?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.

qa.question: Which player chooses the order in which the cards are returned to the deck for this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: The player that activated this effect chooses.

qa.question: If this card's [When Digivolving] effect would return a Digi-Egg card to the deck, is it returned to the Digi-Egg deck?
qa.answer: Yes, it's returned to the Digi-Egg deck.

qa.question: Does this card's [When Digivolving] effect delete 1 of my opponent's Digimon for each card with the [Mega] trait in this card's digivolution cards and return 10 cards in my opponent's trash to the bottom of their deck for each card with the [Mega] trait in this card's digivolution cards?
qa.answer: No. For each card with the [Mega] trait in digivolution cards, you choose 1 of your opponent's Digimon and delete it, but you only return 10 cards from the trash to the deck.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to return cards from my opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck even if they only have 9 or fewer cards in their trash?
qa.answer: Yes, you can return them.

qa.question: Do I have to activate this card's [Start of Your Turn] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you must activate it.

qa.question: This card is in the battle area and it has no digivolution cards. Does this card's [Start of Your Turn] effect trash this card?
qa.answer:
No, it isn't trashed.
If this card doesn't have any digivolution cards, it isn't considered to have any stacked cards, therefore it isn't trashed.

qa.question: This card has digivolution cards, then I place 1 more card on top and digivolve it. At the start of my turn, I activate this card's [Start of Your Turn] effect and trash the top card. Does this card's [Start of Your Turn] effect activate from under it?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't activate.

qa.question: Do I gain 2 memory for this card’s [Start of Your Turn] effect if both me and my opponent have 3 or fewer security cards?
qa.answer: Yes, you gain 2 memory if both of the conditions are met.

qa.question: This card's effect reveals 4 cards. If [BT5-093 Tai Kamiya & Matt Ishida], [BT9-084 Tai Kamiya & Kari Kamiya], or [P-012 Tai Kamiya (V-Tamer)] is one of the cards revealed, can I add that card to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes, those are Tamer cards with [Tai Kamiya] in their names, so you can add one to your hand.

qa.question: Do I gain 2 memory for this card’s [Start of Your Turn] effect if both me and my opponent have 8 or more cards in hand?
qa.answer: Yes, you gain 2 memory if both of the conditions are met.

qa.question: Can I also activate this card’s [Your Turn] effect when one of my blue or red Digimon becomes unsuspended during the unsuspend phase?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Do I gain 2 memory for this card’s [Start of Your Turn] effect if both me and my opponent have a level 5 or higher Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, you gain 2 memory if both of the conditions are met.

qa.question: Do I gain 2 memory for this card’s [Start of Your Turn] effect if both me and my opponent have a suspended Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, you gain 2 memory if both of the conditions are met.

qa.question: This card’s effect reveals 3 cards. If the cards revealed only include either a [Tapirmon] or a 2-color black card, can I still add a card to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes, as long as either a card with [Tapirmon] or a 2-color black card is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

qa.question: If a black Digimon with an effect such as "this Digimon is also treated as red" that treats it as a different color is among the cards revealed for this card's effect, can I add that card to my hand?
qa.answer: No. Effects don't activate for cards revealed from your deck.

qa.question: This card’s effect reveals 3 cards. If the cards revealed only include a Digimon card with the [X Antibody] trait or an Option card with the [X Antibody] trait, can I still add a card to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with the [X Antibody] trait or an Option card with the [X Antibody] trait is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

qa.question: This card's effect reveals 3 cards. If both a Digimon card with the [X Antibody] trait and an Option Card with the [X Antibody] trait are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the other at the bottom of my deck?
qa.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 [...] among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible. In this situation, you must add both 1 Digimon card with the [X Antibody] trait and 1 Option card with the [X Antibody] trait to your hand.

qa.question: Can this card's [Main] effect digivolve a Digimon that doesn't meet the digivolution requirements into a Digimon card with [Shoutmon] in its name in my hand?
qa.answer: No, you can’t ignore digivolution requirements when using this card's effect.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to delete my opponent's Digimon whose total DP adds up to 11000 or less with an "add 1000 to the maximum your DP-based deletion effects can delete" effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to attack my opponent with 1 of my Digimon with [Greymon] in its name that is suspended or was played in the same turn?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This card's effect doesn't let you attack with a Digimon that's in a state where it can't attack.

qa.question: If a digivolution card has the [X Antibody] trait, does it meet this card's "if you have a Digimon with [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards in play" condition?
qa.answer: No. [X Antibody] in this effect's text refers to the card name, therefore only a card with [X Antibody] as its card name will meet the condition. It doesn't refer to the [X Antibody] trait.

qa.question: When I use this card's [Main] effect to attack, does the attacking Digimon's [When Attacking] effect activate?
qa.answer: Yes, it activates.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to have one of my opponent's Digimon attack when one of my Digimon with [Greymon] in its name has a "this Digimon can also attack your opponent's unsuspended Digimon" effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This card's effect only allows you to attack a player.

qa.question: If a digivolution card has the [X Antibody] trait, does it meet this card's "if you have a Digimon with [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards in play" condition?
qa.answer: No. [X Antibody] in this effect's text refers to the card name, therefore only a card with [X Antibody] as its card name will meet the condition. It doesn't refer to the [X Antibody] trait.

qa.question: What does a "your opponent can't play XX by effects" effect do, exactly?
qa.answer:
Such effects prevent your opponent from playing XX by effects.
With this card's effect, your opponent can no longer play Digimon or Tamers by effects such as BT10-018 [Gaossmon]'s [On Deletion] effect or BT9-099 [Sunrise Buster]'s [Main] effect.
This effect affects the opponent player.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to attack an opponent's Digimon with my Digimon with the [Insectoid] trait that was played that turn?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This card's effect doesn't let you attack with a Digimon that's in a state where it can't attack.

qa.question: Can I attack one of my opponent's unsuspended Digimon with this card's effect?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to attack an opponent's Digimon with a "this Digimon can't be attacked" effect?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect when my opponent only has a suspended Digimon or a Tamer?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
In such cases, you activate as many of the effects as possible.

qa.question: After using this card, do level 6 Digimon with the [Machine] trait that are newly played or digivolved in the same turn gain <Rush> and <Blitz> from this card's effect?
qa.answer: Yes. The effect applies to all of your Digimon that meet the conditions, therefore this effect will also affect Digimon that later enter the battle area as long as they meet the conditions.

qa.question: What happens if I use this card while my opponent has [BT9-103 Kongou]'s effect activated?
qa.answer: Due to [BT9-103 Kongou]'s effect, cards can't be placed in security stacks, therefore this card's "place 1 of your opponent's Digimon face down at the top or bottom of your opponent's security stack" can't be activated, and the target Digimon will be left as-is.

qa.question: Does this card's "cards can't be added to security stacks by your opponent's effects" mean that effects that add cards to security stacks on "your opponent's Digimon with play costs of 7 or less" can't be activated?
qa.answer: No. Cards can't be added to security stacks by your opponent's effects regardless of the card type or level (the effects will activate, but cards still can't be added to security stacks). The "your opponent's Digimon with play costs of 7 or less" refers to the "can't attack players" effect.

qa.question: What happens if my opponent activates this card's effect and I use [ST10-14 Chaos Degradation]?
qa.answer: Due to this card's effect, cards can't be placed in security stacks, therefore [ST10-14 Chaos Degradation]'s "place 1 of your opponent's Digimon face down at the top or bottom of your opponent's security stack" can't be activated, and the target Digimon will be left as-is.

qa.question: While my opponent has this card's effect activated, I used [BT10-086 Omnimon (X Antibody)]'s effect to reveal all of my opponent's security cards. After choosing and trashing 1 card among them, can the rest be placed in the security stack?
qa.answer:
Yes, the rest are placed in the security stack.
When returning cards that were revealed from a private area such as the deck or security stack by an effect, it isn't considered adding cards to such areas, therefore this card's effect doesn't apply.

qa.question: It's currently my turn after the turn when my opponent activated BT9-103 [Kongou]'s effect. If I activate this card's [When Digivolving] effect and use an Option card, can I place that Option card on top of the security stack instead of placing it in the trash?
qa.answer:
No, you can't place it in the trash.
BT9-103 [Kongou]'s effect prevents cards from being added to your security stack, so the used Option card is trashed.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect when [BT9-103 Kongou]'s effect is preventing cards from being added to my security stack?
qa.answer: You can activate the effect, but you can't add cards to your security stack, therefore the revealed card can't be added to your security stack and is trashed by the rules.

qa.question: When a digivolution would occur by this card's [Main] effect, when exactly is the timing for the digivolution bonus draw and where do I draw from?
qa.answer:
You perform the digivolution bonus draw when this card is placed on top of that Digimon for the digivolution, and you draw from the unrevealed cards in your deck.
A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules.
After the card to digivolve is stacked and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you process the remaining effects.

qa.question: If I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve, can I activate the digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect before trashing the remaining cards?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: When choosing the target for "then, place 1 card with [X Antibody] in its traits from your trash under 1 of your Digimon with [X Antibody] in its traits as its bottom digivolution card" can I choose a card with the [X Antibody] trait that was revealed from my deck and trashed for this card's effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve into any Digimon card from my trash as long as it has [Dex]/[DeathX] in its name?
qa.answer: No, this effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card from your trash that meets the digivolution requirements and has [Dex]/[DeathX] in its name.

qa.question: Can I activate an effect that reduces the digivolution cost when digivolving using this card's [Main] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, as long as the activation conditions are met.

qa.question: If I use this card's [Main] effect to trash 2 cards in my hand, can I activate <De-Digivolve 1> on 2 of my opponent's Digimon?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This effect only activates <De-Digivolve> on 1 of your opponent's Digimon. For the part of the effect after "then," you can also choose a Digimon other than the target Digimon for <De-Digivolve>.

qa.question: When I use this card's [Main] effect to trash 2 cards in my hand, does <De-Digivolve 1> activate twice or does <De-Digivolve 2> activate once?
qa.answer:
<De-Digivolve 1> activates twice, <De-Digivolve 2> doesn't activate once.
Even if a Tamer card or Option card becomes the top card after trashing the top card, <De-Digivolve> can trash a card regardless of its card category, therefore you go on to trash the 2nd card. However, if a card with an "isn't affected by effects" becomes the top card after the first <De-Digivolve 1>, it won't be affected by the second <De-Digivolve 1> and won't be trashed.

qa.question: Can this card's [When Attacking] effect place one of my [DeadlyAxemon] with BT9-109 [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards at the bottom of this Digimon’s digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes, it can. In such cases, [DeadlyAxemon] becomes a different Digimon, therefore the BT9-109 [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards is trashed according to the rules.

qa.question: Does this card have inherited effects even though it's an Option card?
qa.answer:
Yes. This card's [Main] effect can place it in a Digimon’s digivolution cards, and it has inherited effects.
As with Digi-Egg cards and Digimon cards, this card's inherited effects can activate while it's placed in a Digimon’s digivolution cards.

qa.question: Can this card's inherited effect digivolve a Digimon that doesn't meet the digivolution requirements into a Digimon card with [X Antibody] in its traits in my hand?
qa.answer: No, you can’t ignore digivolution requirements when using this card's effect.

qa.question: Can I activate an effect that reduces the digivolution cost when digivolving using this card's inherited effect?
qa.answer: Yes, as long as the activation conditions are met.

qa.question: Can this card be trashed by <Digi-Burst> effects on Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards?
qa.answer: No. Trashing by <Digi-Burst> is also trashing by an effect.

qa.question: What happens if this card becomes the top card after a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is affected by <De-Digivolve>?
qa.answer:
As with Digimon without DP, this card can't exist in the battle area as the top card, therefore it's trashed. This isn't considered deletion.
If this card has other digivolution cards under it, they are also trashed.

qa.question: What happens if a "trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards of your opponent's Digimon" effect activates on a Digimon with this card as its bottom digivolution card?
qa.answer: Effects can't trash this card, therefore only the digivolution card on top of this card is trashed.

qa.question: There are 8 digivolution cards under [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper], and this card is the bottom card. Does the "you may trash 7 or more digivolution cards from the bottom of 1 of your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper]s to set this Digimon's play cost to 0" effect activate when my [EX2-055 Reaper] is played?
qa.answer: It can activate in such cases if you declare to trash 8 cards and then trash 7 cards except for [BT9-109 X Antibody].

qa.question: If [BT9-109 X Antibody] is in this card’s digivolution cards, can this card’s [End of Your Turn] effect return [BT9-109 X Antibody] from this card’s digivolution cards to the bottom of my deck?
qa.answer: Yes. You're not trashing it, so there’s nothing preventing you from returning it to your deck.

qa.question: My Digimon with [Veedramon] in its name attacks and becomes suspended. After that, it digivolves into a different Digimon with the [When Attacking] effect of [BT9-109 X Antibody] in its digivolution cards. If the card it digivolved into has a [When Digivolving], if I suspend this card with this card's [All Turns] effect, can I activate the [When Digivolving] effect of the card it digivolved into?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: When this card's effect places 1 of my other blue Digimon as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, if that Digimon has [BT9-109 X Antibody] in its digivolution cards, what happens to that card?
qa.answer: It's not being trashed by the effect, it's being trashed because of the rules, so [BT9-109 X Antibody] does still get trashed.

qa.question: When I use this card's effect to place a blue Digimon as the bottom digivolution card of another Digimon, what happens if that Digimon has [BT9-109 X Antibody] in its digivolution cards?
qa.answer: It's not being trashed by the effect, it's being trashed because of the rules, so [BT9-109 X Antibody] does still get trashed.

qa.question: When this card's effect places [Shoutmon] in this Digimon's digivolution cards, what happens if [Shoutmon] has [BT9-109 X Antibody] in its digivolution cards?
qa.answer: It's not being trashed by the effect, it's being trashed because of the rules, so [BT9-109 X Antibody] does still get trashed.

qa.question: There are 8 digivolution cards under this card, and [BT9-109 X Antibody] is the bottom card. Does the "you may trash 7 or more digivolution cards from the bottom of 1 of your [Mother D-Reaper]s to set this Digimon's play cost to 0" effect activate when my [EX2-055 Reaper] is played?
qa.answer: It can activate in such cases if you declare to trash 8 cards and then trash 7 cards except for [X Antibody].

qa.question: There are 8 digivolution cards under my EX2-007 [Mother D-Reaper], including 1 BT9-109 [X Antibody]. Can this card's 1st effect activate when this card would be played?
qa.answer: Yes, it can be activated. As long as you can trash 7 or more digivolution cards from the bottom other than cards that can't be trashed, the play cost will be 0.

qa.question: Does this card's "if there are 3 or more Digimon in play" refer to 3 or more total Digimon in play by both me and my opponent?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: Can I activate just the "delete 1 Digimon without [X Antibody] in its traits" effect when there are 3 or more Digimon in play?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
When there are 3 or more Digimon in play, you must delete all Digimon without [X Antibody] in their traits.

qa.question: If this card’s [End of Your Turn] effect gains me enough memory to bring the memory gauge to 0 or greater on my side, does it briefly become my opponent’s turn before switching back to my turn again?
qa.answer: No. In this case, your turn simply continues without switching over.

qa.question: If [BT9-109 X Antibody] is in this card’s digivolution cards, can this card’s [End of Your Turn] effect return [BT9-109 X Antibody] from this card’s digivolution cards to the bottom of my deck?
qa.answer: Yes. You're not trashing it, so there’s nothing preventing you from returning it to your deck.

qa.question: If my Digimon is targeted by the [End of Opponent's Turn] effect of my opponent's [BT9-112 DeathXmon] while it has this card in its digivolution cards, does this card's inherited effect prevent it from being deleted due to my opponent's effect?
qa.answer: No, this card's inherited effect has the [Opponent's Turn] timing, but the turns haven't changed at the end of your turn, so this card's inherited effect can't be activated and the effect of your opponent's [BT9-112 DeathXmon] can't be prevented.

qa.question: When playing this card, do I reduce its memory cost by 3 for each pair of Digimon and Tamer cards my opponent has in play?
qa.answer:
No, you reduce its memory cost by 3 based on the total number of Digimon and Tamer cards your opponent has in play.
For example, if your opponent has 2 Digimon and 1 Tamer, this adds up to 3 cards total, which means you get to reduce the play cost by 9.

comprehensive-0223.title: <Blocker>
comprehensive-0223.text:
16-5. <Blocker>
16-5-1. <Blocker> is a keyword effect that applies a rule that allows a Digimon with that effect to block. (For details, refer to 12 "Blocking")
16-5-2. <Blocker> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-5-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Blocker>, the number of blocks that can be performed during the block timing is only 1.

comprehensive-0224.title: <Recovery>
comprehensive-0224.text:
16-6. <Recovery>
16-6-1. <Recovery> is a keyword effect where the specified number of cards from the specified area are placed face down on top of the security stack. This is shown on cards using text such as <Recovery +1>.
16-6-2. <Recovery> effects execute processing.

comprehensive-0225.title: <Piercing>
comprehensive-0225.text:
16-7. <Piercing>
16-7-1. <Piercing> is a keyword effect that reads "When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, it checks security before the attack ends." (For details, refer to 13 "Security Checks")
16-7-2. <Piercing> is a trigger-type effect that triggers and activates when a Digimon with this effect battles an opponent's Digimon and the opponent's Digimon is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger- Type Effects")
16-7-3. The security check from using <Piercing> is mandatory.
16-7-4. <Piercing> is pending processing that is processed immediately before the transition to the end of attack timing. Therefore, it will trigger simultaneously with effects triggered by the battle, but it is processed before the end of the attack. (Example: If a Digimon with <Piercing> attacks and deletes a Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect in the battle, first the [On Deletion] effect is resolved, then <Piercing> is processed.)
16-7-5. Only 1 security check can be performed during a single attack, even if <Piercing> activates multiple times. However, if the number of cards that can be checked by the attacking Digimon is modified, that number of cards will be checked in a single security check.
16-7-6. If there are no Digimon to perform a security check at the point when <Piercing> is processed, a security check won't be possible.

comprehensive-0226.title: <Draw>
comprehensive-0226.text:
16-8. <Draw>
16-8-1. <Draw> is a keyword effect where a player draws the cards from their deck according to the number specified in the effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Draw 1>.
16-8-2. <Draw> effects execute processing.
16-8-3. A draw from <Draw> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0229.title: <Reboot>
comprehensive-0229.text:
16-11. <Reboot>
16-11-1. <Reboot> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect is unsuspended during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-2. <Reboot> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-11-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Reboot>, it is only unsuspended once during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-4. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is mandatory.
16-11-5. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is performed at the same time as the unsuspending of the turn player's Digimon. The unsuspends aren't performed in any particular order.

comprehensive-0230.title: <De-Digivolve>
comprehensive-0230.text:
16-12. <De-Digivolve>
16-12-1. <De-Digivolve> is a keyword effect where the player declares a number from 1 up to the number specified in the effect, then the declared number of cards are trashed from the chosen stack(s) of cards starting with the top card. This is shown on cards using text such as <De- Digivolve 1>.
16-12-2. <De-Digivolve> effects execute processing.
16-12-3. The trashing from <De-Digivolve> is mandatory. Once activated, a player can't choose to trash 0 cards.
16-12-4. <De-Digivolve> can't trash cards from level 3 cards or lower.
16-12-5. If multiple cards are trashed using 1 instance of <De- Digivolve>, all of the cards are considered to be trashed at the same time, but the procedure for trashing them is 1 card from the stack at a time.
16-12-6. When using <De-Digivolve> to trash multiple cards, even if the category of the top card changes while the trashing is still being performed, the trashing will continue until the declared number is trashed.
16-12-7. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the processing is performed separately for each instance.
16-12-8. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the state of the chosen card is confirmed after each single process for <De-Digivolve> ends. If an effect will be activated as a result of the confirmed state, it is then activated. (Example: When 3 instances of <De-Digivolve 1> are executed in a single effect, if the chosen card becomes an "unaffected by effects" card as a result of the 1st instance of <De-Digivolve 1>, that card is unaffected by the following instances of <De-Digivolve 1>.

comprehensive-0231.title: <Retaliation>
comprehensive-0231.text:
16-13. <Retaliation>
16-13-1. <Retaliation> is a keyword effect where a battled opponent's Digimon is deleted when a Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle.
16-13-2. <Retaliation> is a trigger-type effect that triggers when just the Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger-Type Effects")
16-13-3. The processing from <Retaliation> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0233.title: <Rush>
comprehensive-0233.text:
16-15. <Rush>
16-15-1. <Rush> is a keyword effect where the Digimon with this effect can also attack in the same turn it was played.
16-15-2. <Rush> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")

comprehensive-0234.title: <Blitz>
comprehensive-0234.text:
16-16. <Blitz>
16-16-1. <Blitz> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect can attack if your opponent has 1 or more memory.
16-16-2. <Blitz> effects execute processing.
16-16-3. <Blitz> has a processing condition that requires the memory to be at 1 or more on your opponent's side. "This Digimon may attack" is optional processing.
16-16-4. After using <Blitz> to make an attack declaration, the attack will proceed even if the memory moves to 0 or more.38
16-16-5. An attack can't be made using <Blitz> if the memory is at 0 or more upon activating <Blitz>.

comprehensive-0237.title: <Armor Purge>
comprehensive-0237.text:
16-19. <Armor Purge>
16-19-1. <Armor Purge> is a keyword effect. When a Digimon with <Armor Purge> would be deleted, by trashing the top card of the Digimon with this effect, this effect prevents the deletion.
16-19-2. <Armor Purge> is an immediate-type effect that triggers when the Digimon with this effect would be deleted. (For details, refer to 15-8-5 "Immediate-Type Effects")
16-19-3. "By trashing the top card of the Digimon" in <Armor Purge> is an optional processing condition. If the content of that condition is executed, the processing for "prevents the deletion" will be mandatory.
